modelNotes: Rebounds Board 1.0 uses season rebounds, last 5 rebounds, last 10 rebounds, expected minutes, minutes confidence, position role, and recent rebound trend.
Rebounds Board 2.0 adds minutes scaling, opponent rebound rank, pace, rest, teammate absence redistribution, volatility, and floor/ceiling ranges.
No odds or betting lines are used.

injury.shortComment: Embiid (foot) is questionable to suit up for Monday's game against the Bulls.
injury.detail: Embiid missed Saturday's 109-104 win over Charlotte due to right foot plantar fascia injury management, and he's now in jeopardy of missing a second consecutive game for the same reason. If he's unable to play Monday, Adem Bona will likely earn another start with Jabari Walker getting additional minutes off the bench.

injury.shortComment: Johnson (ankle) is questionable to play Monday against the Pacers.
injury.detail: Johnson did not return to Saturday's 121-99 loss to New Orleans after suffering a left ankle sprain in the third quarter. He's now been tagged as questionable, and if he is in fact out versus Indiana, Aaron Wiggins and Luguentz Dort are the top candidates to join the starting five for Atlanta.

injury.shortComment: Smith (finger) is listed as probable for Monday's game against Philadelphia.
injury.detail: Smith is battling a finger injury but is expected to suit up versus the 76ers. With Nicolas Claxton (hamstring) listed as doubtful, Smith will presumably remain in the starting lineup.

injury.shortComment: Poeltl (shoulder) won't play in Sunday's game against the Lakers, Vivek Jacob of the Raptors' official site reports.
injury.detail: Poeltl was a confirmed starter Sunday. However, a shoulder injury will keep him off the floor versus the Lakers. Without Poeltl, Trayce Jackson-Davis will enter the starting lineup.

injury.shortComment: Sarr (knee) is questionable to play in Monday's game against the Magic.
injury.detail: Sarr seems to have picked up the knee issue after logging a season-high 29 minutes during Friday's 95-79 win over Charlotte. If he's unable to suit up in Orlando, Deandre Ayton would likely earn his first start of the season.

injury.shortComment: Capela (ankle) is questionable to play in Monday's game against the Celtics.
injury.detail: Capela is dealing with a sprained right ankle that has him questionable to suit up versus Boston. With Steven Adams (calf) already ruled out, Oscar Tshiebwe would likely absorb backup minutes behind Alperen Sengun if Capela is sidelined.

injury.shortComment: Awaka (ankle) is probable for Monday's game against Philadelphia.
injury.detail: Awaka played 12 minutes during Friday's 125-111 loss to the Celtics after missing one game with the ankle issue. The rookie big man will continue to provide depth off the bench for the Bulls behind Jalen Smith.

injury.shortComment: Murphy (knee) is listed as probable for Monday's game against the Grizzlies.
injury.detail: Murphy is dealing with bilateral patella tendinopathy, leaving him probable to suit up versus the 6-0 Grizzlies. If he's forced to sit out Monday, Saddiq Bey would stand as the primary beneficiary alongside Trendon Watford, with Bey the likely candidate to join the starting lineup.

injury.shortComment: Toppin (back) is out for Sunday's game against the Nets, Alex Golden of SI.com reports.
injury.detail: After missing Friday's 145-125 loss to the Heat, Toppin will miss his second straight contest due to lower back soreness. Sunday's matchup with Brooklyn is the first of a back-to-back set for Indiana, so the hope is that Toppin will be able to suit up on Monday. In his absence, Jarace Walker and Jalen Slawson should continue earning more minutes off the bench.

injury.shortComment: Jones (right knee) has been ruled out for the rest of Sunday's game against the Clippers, Ohm Youngmisuk of ESPN.com reports.
injury.detail: Jones appeared to sustain the injury in the third quarter of Sunday's game, and he'll be sidelined for the rest of the contest. Gradey Dick and Kobe Sanders are both in line for minutes the rest of the way in the absence of Jones, who will finish with nine points (3-11 FG, 1-5 3Pt, 2-2 FT), seven rebounds and one assist over 28 minutes.

injury.shortComment: Watson (hamstring) is questionable to play in Monday's game against Oklahoma City.
injury.detail: Watson is battling soreness in his right hamstring, an ailment that has put his status for Monday's contest in jeopardy. With Jaylon Tyson (ankle) already ruled out, the Cavs could be thin on the wings, while Sam Merrill, Mario Hezonja and Meleek Thomas would all stand to see increased playing time if Watson is forced to miss his first outing of the season.

injury.shortComment: Irving (knee) is questionable to play Monday against the Kings.
injury.detail: Irving could miss his second contest of the season as he works his way back from an ACL tear in his left knee. He played a season-high 35 minutes during Friday's 116-111 win over Houston, so it's possible Dallas gives him some additional time to rest on Monday. If that is indeed the case, Walter Clayton Jr. and Marcus Sasser are the top candidates to join the starting unit, while Cooper Flagg's usage would see a major boost.

injury.shortComment: LaVine (elbow) is questionable to play in Monday's game against Dallas.
injury.detail: LaVine played a season-low 21 minutes during Saturday's 136-105 loss to Memphis, but it's unclear if that was due to the elbow soreness or the game being out of reach for the Kings. Either way, his status will bear monitoring ahead of Monday's clash with the Mavericks. If he's unable to play, Darius Acuff Jr.'s usage would skyrocket, while Malik Monk, Emanuel Sharp and Nique Clifford could all see increased opportunities in the backcourt.

injury.shortComment: Post (ankle) is questionable to suit up for Monday's game against New Orleans.
injury.detail: Post missed Saturday's 136-105 victory over Sacramento with a sprained right ankle, and he's now in jeopardy of missing a second straight contest with the injury. If he's unable to play, Isaiah Stewart and Taylor Hendricks will split the backup center minutes.

injury.shortComment: Santos did not play in the second half of Sunday's 124-112 win over the Clippers due to a knee injury and will not play against the Suns on Monday, Danny Emerman of SFStandard.com reports.
injury.detail: Santos has been working through a knee injury that he picked up in preseason action in mid-October, and he was initially tagged as questionable for Sunday's game before being cleared to play. Head coach Steve Kerr told reporters after the game that the Warriors need "to get [Santos] right," so it's possible that the fifth-year forward is facing an extended absence beyond Monday's contest. Georges Niang and Al Horford both figure to see an uptick in playing time in Santos' absence.

injury.shortComment: Sheppard (back) is questionable for Monday's game against the Celtics.
injury.detail: Sheppard is in danger of missing his fourth game of the 2026-27 campaign. With Fred VanVleet (knee) not listed on the injury report, Marcus Smart could continue to be more involved than usual if Sheppard can't suit up Monday.

injury.shortComment: Brown (rest) is out for Sunday's game in Indiana.
injury.detail: Brown will skip the first leg of this upcoming back-to-back set, but he should return for Monday's game in New York. With Brown inactive, there will be more minutes available for Nolan Traore, Terance Mann and Keon Ellis.

injury.shortComment: Flemings (suspension) won't play in Monday's game against Indiana, Andrew Schlecht of The Athletic reports.
injury.detail: Flemings was assessed a technical foul and ejected late in the Hawks' 121-99 loss to New Orleans on Saturday for intentionally elbowing Pelicans guard Bryce McGowens in the head. Without the rookie on the floor, head coach Quin Snyder will presumably divide the minutes between Dyson Daniels, Nickeil Alexander-Walker, Aaron Wiggins and CJ McCollum.

injury.shortComment: Pippen (back) is listed as doubtful for Monday's game against the Pelicans.
injury.detail: Pippen didn't suit up for Saturday's 136-105 win over the Kings. With Pippen in line to miss another game Monday, Cam Spencer will likely be on the floor more than usual behind Ty Jerome (back), who is not listed on the injury report for the meeting with New Orleans.

injury.shortComment: Hardaway (personal) is listed as questionable for Monday's game against the Lakers.
injury.detail: Hardaway is dealing with a personal issue and is in danger of missing his first game of the 2026-27 campaign. If he can't suit up Monday in Los Angeles, Dru Smith and Nikola Jovic should see more minutes.

injury.shortComment: Swain (back) has been ruled out for Friday's game against Boston.
injury.detail: Swain will be held out of Friday's contest due to lower-back soreness. His next chance to play will come Monday at Philadelphia.

injury.shortComment: Gill (back) is questionable to suit up in Monday's contest against Orlando.
injury.detail: Gill is dealing with back spasms that will leave his status questionable versus the Magic. He's played a total of just one minute in 2026-27, so even if he's sidelined Monday, it won't have any impact on the rotation.
